Description

In Cells of Time, you're the architect of a cellular world governed by the rules of Conway’s Game of Life. With just a few initial strokes, you shape the first generation—and then let time take over. Your challenge: design a pattern that will endure through 1,000 years of evolution... or maybe even longer.

History

Trijam #321

Game developed in 3 hours for Trijam #321 (https://itch.io/jam/trijam-321). Theme: "1000 years"

Development

The game was brought to life with C# and Blazor WebAssembly, powered by my own game engine, Blazorame!
